proof_body:
by
  intro a b x
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun y => a * y + b) a x := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul a).add_const b
  constructor
  · exact h.sin.congr_deriv (by ring)
  · exact h.cos.congr_deriv (by ring)
target_source: ∀ (a b x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun y => Real.sin (a * y + b)) (a * Real.cos (a * x + b)) x ∧ HasDerivAt (fun y => Real.cos (a * y + b)) (-(a * Real.sin (a * x + b))) x
